claim: Celebrities including Drew Barrymore, Reese Witherspoon and Ashley Graham joined the trend.
excerpt: Barrymore 'kinda chic to be in your 50s'; Witherspoon with Laura Dern on supporting women; Graham on cellulite and body confidence. The same search summary said Boots ('reapply your SPF'), Aldi (sock hanger) and Virgin Atlantic used the format; the exact source page wasn't confirmed.
title: Why the 'Kinda Chic' trend has celebrities joining in
